CVE-2026-123863.title: Node.js is vulnerable to a remote HTTP/2 denial of service via a reachable assertion in Http2Session teardown
CVE-2026-123863.description: A reachable assertion in Node.js HTTP/2 session teardown lets any unauthenticated client abort the server, over both TLS and cleartext. A client can arrange for an Http2Stream that still holds nghttp2-allocated header buffers to outlive its session: the stream is removed from the session's stream set but never detached, so when ~Http2Session() runs the memory accounting is nonzero and the CHECK_EQ(current_nghttp2_memory_, 0) assertion fails, terminating the process. The trigger needs only a default http2 server whose handler responds before the request body has ended, which is typical. It is a variant of CVE-2024-27983 that the earlier fix did not cover, because that fix only detached streams still tracked in the session. This vulnerability affects Node.js 26.x (since 26.9.0) and 24.x (since 24.22.0).

CVE-2026-131868.title: Convert::ASN1 versions before 0.37 for Perl allow memory exhaustion via a declared element length passed unchecked to sysread in asn_read and asn_get
CVE-2026-131868.description:
Convert::ASN1 versions before 0.37 for Perl allow memory exhaustion via a declared element length passed unchecked to sysread in asn_read and asn_get.

The length an element declares in its BER header is passed to sysread as the read size. Perl grows the target buffer to that size before reading, so memory is allocated from the declared length, not from the data received. A 6-byte header can declare a length of up to 4GB.

A single header makes the reading process allocate the declared size. Where the allocation fails, perl exits with "Out of memory", which eval cannot catch.

CVE-2026-99294.title: netfilter: nft_fwd_netdev: use recursion counter in neigh egress path
CVE-2026-99294.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

netfilter: nft_fwd_netdev: use recursion counter in neigh egress path

nft_fwd_neigh can be used in egress chains (NF_NETDEV_EGRESS). When the
forwarding rule targets the same device or two devices forward to each
other, neigh_xmit() triggers dev_queue_xmit() which re-enters
nf_hook_egress(), causing infinite recursion and stack overflow.

Move the nf_get_nf_dup_skb_recursion() accessor and NF_RECURSION_LIMIT
to the shared header nf_dup_netdev.h as a static inline, so that
nft_fwd_netdev can use the recursion counter directly without exported
function call overhead. Guard neigh_xmit() with the same recursion
limit already used in nf_do_netdev_egress().

[ Updated to cache the nf_get_nf_dup_skb_recursion pointer. --pablo ]

CVE-2026-99500.title: s390/pci: Fix resource leak in zpci MSI setup
CVE-2026-99500.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

s390/pci: Fix resource leak in zpci MSI setup

If airq_iv_create() fails in __alloc_airq(), the zpci_sbv bit allocated
by airq_iv_alloc_bit() is never freed. This permanently leaks one of the
ZPCI_NR_DEVICES summary bits, reducing system capacity with each failed
device hotplug. In systems with repeated device insertion failures or
under memory pressure, all summary bits can be exhausted, preventing new
PCI devices from being added until reboot.

Add proper error handling to free the zpci_sbv bit and reset zdev->aisb
if the AIBV creation fails.

CVE-2026-99683.title: vduse: fix VA/PA confusion in the coherent page fault path
CVE-2026-99683.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

vduse: fix VA/PA confusion in the coherent page fault path

vduse_domain_get_coherent_page() assumes that iotlb entries above
bounce_size were installed by vduse_domain_alloc_coherent(), so it
treats map->addr as a physical address. But vduse registers with
use_va = true, and when the device is bound to vhost_vdpa,
vhost_vdpa_va_map() stores a userspace virtual address in map->addr,
which vduse_domain_set_map() then copies into the same iotlb. A
process holding the domain file descriptor across a rebind can
therefore fault in an arbitrary physical page with read/write
access, ignoring the entry permissions.

Additionally, since the domain file mmap lacks VM_IO, the domain
file itself can be mapped and passed to vhost_vdpa_va_map(),
producing self-referential entries that bypass the coherent path
check.

To fix, only translate entries whose backing file is the domain
file itself in vduse_domain_get_coherent_page(),…

CVE-2026-99737.title: mm/shmem: fix truncate loop after boundary swapin failure
CVE-2026-99737.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

mm/shmem: fix truncate loop after boundary swapin failure

If swapping in a large entry at the new EOF fails, shmem_undo_range()
leaves the entry in place. Its final scan skips the entry, then restarts
from the same start index and finds it again. Truncation can loop forever
while holding i_rwsem.

Advance start past the skipped entry so that a restarted scan can finish,
as we already do for folios that cannot be split.

Note that this does not fix the missing zeroing when boundary swapin fails,
it merely prevents the endless loop.
